common.buildFirstBotTitle: Build your first bot in minutes
common.buildFirstBotDesc: A quick tour of the SDK and the dashboard panel you'll use to manage commands, plugins, and analytics. The snippets below are simplified examples — swap in your own bot token from the dashboard, never commit real tokens to source control.
common.panelPreviewTitle: What the management panel looks like
common.panelPreviewDesc: Once your bot is created, everything is managed from one dashboard — no need to redeploy code for simple changes.

landing.taglineSub: Build, deploy, and scale advanced Telegram bots and Mini Apps. The power of code, the speed of no-code, wrapped in a developer-first experience.
landing.engineeredSub: Everything you need to run production bots, right out of the box.
landing.readyToForgeSub: Join thousands of Iranian developers building the next generation of Telegram experiences.
landing.madeWith: Made with pride for Iranian developers.
landing.advancedCommandsDesc: Visual builder meets code. Define complex logic, argument parsing, and permissions with ease.
landing.pluginMarketplaceDesc: One-click install plugins. Analytics, moderation, payments, AI integrations, and more.
landing.instantDeployDesc: Push changes instantly without downtime. Real-time logging and performance monitoring.
landing.enterpriseSecurityDesc: Role-based permissions, token management, and full audit logs for your team.
landing.analyticsDashboardDesc: Track users, messages, uptime, and revenue with beautiful real-time charts.
landing.multiBotManagementDesc: Control unlimited bots from one dashboard. Switch contexts in seconds.
landing.heroBadge: Platform v2.0 — Built for Iran's builders
